payload.title: README says every agent must specify a provider, but the docs say it is optional
payload.description:
**Problem**
The Tactus README and the published docs contradict each other on whether an agent's `provider:` is required.

**Evidence**
README.md (origin/develop) line 976: "**Every agent must specify a `provider:`** (either directly or via `default_provider:` at the procedure level)." The docs site treats the provider as optional (per the audit; confirm which is true against the runtime).

**Fix**
Check runtime behaviour, then make the README and the docs agree.

**How to verify**
`git show origin/develop:README.md | grep -n 'provider'` and the matching docs page state the same rule, and a minimal agent without `provider:` behaves as documented.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
